minutes.headline: Cemetery Commission approved paying the cemetery building vouchers and the FY22 article, and planned grub control and parking-lot bids.
minutes.summary: The commission heard the DPW director's update on the North Cemetery garage building, parking lot grant deadline and grass/grub damage. It approved the February minutes and the building vouchers, and discussed dog waste, a thank-you letter to Monty Tech, and moving the next meeting. The chair thanked departing member Lorraine for six years of service before adjourning.

budget_items.what_was_said: Grant money secured by the town manager has a June deadline, so the project must go to bid or quotes soon; an extension may be requested.
Commission recommended appropriating a sum from the sale of lots account at town meeting to fund operating costs and fieldstones for the Goodrich yard wall.
Powell Construction's grading, crushed asphalt and loam work will be paid after July 1.
Hydroseeding by Lakeview is to be paid shortly from the current appropriation.
Chair reviewed line by line the vouchers for donuts and pizza for students, lumber and roofing, doors, electrical, siding reimbursed to Monty Tech, and a dumpster.
A sign for the new building was approved for payment with the vouchers.
The commission has a small balance left until July, with the hydroseeding to come out of it; the project finished roughly on budget.
The town now provides an annual maintenance budget for outsourced work like hedges and tree cutting.

decisions.decision: DPW director will follow up with the engineer on parking lot plan revisions and ask the town manager about a grant extension or quotes instead of a full bid.
Develop a staged grub control and overseeding plan for the cemeteries after July, before announcing it publicly.
Chair will ask Todd to put a camera up for a month to identify the dog owner at North Cemetery.
Chair will draft a thank-you letter to Monty Tech and look into whether the commission can donate to the program.
Next meeting tentatively moved from May 20 to the week after so the incoming member can be sworn in.

what_happened.line: The Cemetery Commission voted to pay the building vouchers for the new North Cemetery building, with three members in favor.
The DPW director said the parking lot grant has a June deadline, so the project must go to bid or quotes soon, and an extension may be requested.
The commission agreed to develop a staged grub control and overseeding plan for after July, before announcing it publicly.
The commission said the building project finished roughly on budget, with a small balance left until July that hydroseeding will draw on.
The chair will ask for a camera at North Cemetery to identify a dog owner, and will draft a thank-you letter to Monty Tech.

why_it_matters: The new cemetery building was built with Monty Tech student labor and came in roughly on budget, so its cost is largely settled and paid from the current appropriation.
The parking lot work depends on grant money with a June deadline, and a missed deadline could mean the town pays for it some other way.
watch_next: The parking lot bid or quotes, or a grant extension request, before the June deadline.
The next meeting, tentatively moved from May 20 to the week after so the incoming member can be sworn in.
